text: PR #5428 round 3 fix (commit 5c285d90c): the round-2 re-walk used full identity comparison (including link_count) via operator!=, contradicting this call site's own comment that it has no link_count-dependent invariant -- risked spuriously failing the whole build on a benign transient link_count change (AV/backup tool briefly hard-linking the artifact). Fixed to use content_equal() instead, matching the comment and content_equal()'s original design intent. Re-verified locally the regression test still catches the rename/replace case. Deferred a second finding (generic error code + no retry across 6 failure modes in this function, confirmed pre-existing not a regression) as issue #5435. Judged a 4th adversarial review round unnecessary given the mechanical, single-line nature of this fix -- exact-head Windows Native Validation redispatched (run 33466415485), will merge once green.
